tool_selection.reasoning: SHAP provides consistent, interpretable attribution scores across features, allowing detection of shared high-importance features in misclassified instances. LIME and Integrated Gradients offer complementary local and global explanations, helping validate whether spurious features dominate predictions. Sensitivity analysis isolates the causal impact of each feature, confirming whether removing a shared feature reduces prediction error. Together, these tools provide both quantitative and qualitative evidence of shared spurious features.
